Actual True Seeing identifies imagery but is not a blanket cancellation of this Enchantment stun. Preserve other actual Stunned sources independently.

completeSharedRules.text:
Only actual classAccess, acquisition, school and repertoire authorize casting. All16 retain rank7, base17RP and Action; V/S/F except Reverse Gravity's actual M/F alternative. Use the completed real class engine, pricing/cadence, preparation, usable components and known-target preflight. At a legal direct commitment spend the Action and all actual costs, update history, establish any new concentration burden and end incompatible old concentration before countering or payload. A paid failure, counter, hidden ineligibility or invalidated target refunds nothing. Rank7 ordinary base Dissonance is2; actual protected Wizard prepared-family first use waives base only, not Refrain or explicit additional strain. Actual class School Mastery, school passive, wards, repertoire gates and automatic effects apply. No spell title, copy, acquired resource pool or this manuscript supplies a missing class entitlement.
Ordinary Ready is unchanged: prepare the fixed spell/mode with actual costs, components, casting history and its one cast-interruption window; maintain its one concentration burden; select targets/area at release after the completed trigger; pay the real Reaction; use current legal target/geometry and the existing next-own-regular-START deadline. The hold remains concentrated through resolution, then continues only for a concentrating payload. No second casting/payment/history/counter window. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains preparation-only within its copied-feat scope and does not alter ordinary Ready.
Known impossibility precludes commitment. Hidden source predicates are resolved at their named checkpoint without providing a failure-reason or target-list oracle. Every optional class addition needs actual acquisition, payment and qualification. No automatic upcast, resource refund, recharge reset, free Action or extra turn is added.

NEW local adoption of the exact DC25 continuous-world convention for these16, not global replacement of older grids: measure occupied3D bodies in Euclidean feet. Single-creature range is minimum actual body separation plus real perception/line of effect. A point is personally perceived, in actual printed range from the caster's body and has caster-to-point line of effect. Recipient admission to a sphere/cylinder/cone requires one actual intersecting body witness with line of effect from the declared effect origin to that same witness. Closed boundaries count, apart from an expressly excluded origin-only caster contact. Store origin/orientation before results and revalidate after genuine interrupts. Fix the recipient set once; later cover destruction does not rescan it.
All-creature effects include the caster and allies when eligible. Selective arcs require the stated perceived chosen recipients. Mass Confusion instead has its own area breadth: individual perception is expressly NOT required. Its enemy predicate uses actual ordinary known opposition rather than a hidden faction/alignment lookup; the private world query does not expose its set. This is a local override, not an amendment to DC25's separately selected enemy-targeted cards.
An effect cannot target equipment, objects, corpse remains or false images unless its own operation permits it. Reverse Gravity expressly includes actual objects/custody assemblies. Source geometry cannot manufacture a real body, wall, support, required material profile or physical route. All imagery and resulting physics use actual source-qualified shapes and positions, not display sprites.

Actual caster attack/DC and actual defenses govern; binary saves have no generic natural1/20 special result. Attacks natural1 miss and natural20 critically double dice, not constants. One shared raw pool for each specified area/chain supplies separate recipient events. Prismatic uses its declared separate recipient pools. Apply save half with floor when and only when specified, then actual defense/temporaryHP/normalHP/life/Wound/concentration processing. Keep separate packets separate; Wounds do not reduce maximum HP. Actual damage/root/transfer/recovery clauses retain their exact scopes. Damage-type immunity is not automatically immunity to a separate control component.
Each actual admitted instantaneous recipient event creates its original-caster root and captures actual source-qualified Null at that event's declared creation checkpoint. A wholly prevented manifestation has no damage packet or root. Charges, marks, delayed blasts and ground contacts use their separately stated checkpoints. Pure transfer retains its root and does not repeat the effect's rider.
NEW R7M-INSTANT-BATCH-01, only Pyroclasm's initial burst, Arcbolt Singularity, Prismatic Spray and Whirlwind: after permission/interruptions and one immutable recipient snapshot, create the finite admitted instantaneous recipient applications. An application in that already-created batch is not deleted merely because the batch's own harm ends the released ordinary Ready hold. The concentration failure/life consequences happen immediately. No batch exists if the hold was lost before creation. Future ongoing effects still require their actual remaining permissions; this is not a rule for every spell or deferred event.

Explicit absolute60-second sources expire at establishment+60 before simultaneous new commitments, with Delayed Blast's expressly selected terminal detonation as its exception. Preserve original typed regular markers through reorder, departure and extra turns. 'Next future' excludes an underway turn; a repeat save expressly at affected regular END can include the underway END. A clock is not an Action, Reaction refresh, recharge, body, death save or catch-up event.
Actual Stunned/whole-Action denial claims one original-source-character/recipient/encounter guard only on genuine admission. Suppression, replacement and ending never refund it. Prevented hard admission has no invented fallback. Narrow defenses remain narrow. Mandatory instructions compete for actual remaining budgets using their true issue times.
NEW local END-only bridge for Power Word Pain and Dominate Greater Beast: independent recipients use affected actual regular END, including current. Outside a real sequence use admission+6 then every6. Actual attached-phase END may consume the next opportunity without creating a turn. Store last-resolved/admission anchor; absent-phase resumption uses strictly future anchored multiples, not transition time or catch-up. Map into real phases once, no double save at coincident markers; retain original deadline. Mass Confusion separately uses the explicitly extended lower Confusion behavior/phase contract. Prismatic and Symbol use only their specified one-future-END or6-second rider endpoint.
Actual one-shot entitlements, finite tick counts and command permissions do not refill when a timer is amended. Lasting Control's only new duration authority is precisely its own procedure.

Inherit complete actually selected Lesser Antimagic, Greater Dispel, Globe, and accepted Resonance3 rules only within their scopes. Rank7 remains above Globe's incoming0–5 ceiling; lower paidRP never changes rank. Caster-in-zone, source-anchor, target-attached expression and target-local prevention are different predicates. No imagined projectile path imports suppression to a nonprojectile.
Suppression pauses no deadline, restores no charge/used condition or skipped action, and creates no replay queue. Whole source endings and local temporary expression suppression remain distinct; each procedure states its loci. Completed damage, movement and ordinary material do not disappear on later dispel. Greater Dispel captures its entire actually eligible co-located set before resolving source checks; rank7 has DC24 under its actual procedure, one result per generating cast for captured children.
Use existing source-qualified pricing, dealer/root ownership, refund, conversion and finite-field arbitration when those actual fields exist. Fixtures without those fields receive no inferred enhancement, discount or RP conversion. Missing runtime routing is not a new exception or a permission to weaken these sources.

Keep original cast ID, school/rank/owner, payment, cast-history chronology, recipient application IDs, immutable sets, source roots, deadlines, consumed opportunities and cleanup receipts. Duplicate delivery, save/reload, owner/control changes and new UI IDs cannot reproduce a charge, roll, hit, move, recovery or ending.
Effect-table, target-set and private behavior draws do not become player information. Existing five DE4 presentations stay scoped; this cohort adds no sixth. Mass Confusion's reuse of a d4 table does not automatically copy the specifically named lower Confusion presentation. Observable outcomes occur normally but there is no new raw future RNG, hidden HP, enemy roster, immunity reason or source inventory.
Cleanup removes only this source's still-maintained state. Independently created child payloads/recipient riders persist exactly where explicitly stated: Crown's committed shot, Delayed Blast's one blast and Symbol's delivered stuns. Class awards require their existing durable source and frequency receipts. No canonical integration, engine execution, balance or world-authentication claim follows from these authored data.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: LG60
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Use initial DEX,60-second nonconcentration one-use mark; a saved-against cast does not replace an old mark. The printed10d8 is contingent on later qualifying behavior, not entry damage.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Preserves reaction deterrence without automatic damage on admission. Duration/save/replacement are NEW.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: LGtrigger
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: A genuinely new deliberate Action/BA/Reaction or voluntary movement segment triggers after paid commitment and before main outcome; forced movement and existing underway actions do not. Consume the mark first; suppression observes no triggers and queues nothing.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Defines 'move or act' without prohibiting agency or refunding native commitments. No new interrupt source.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: PyroShape
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Keep literal20ft cast range, NEW radius20 sphere, all qualifying creatures/cover in one immutable snapshot.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Do not silently repair short range to120. Caster/self-exclusion follows only actual class permission.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: PyroGround
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Initial10d6 DEX full/half and NEW60-second original-ground aftermath2d6 at contact/regularSTART, once per specified family/recipient/round, no creation double-hit.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Ground benefit remains useful but requires actual support; no new Burning, fuel or physical fire.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Initial CON full/half8d8; only failure admits independently defended half-Speed. No bundled lower Slow mechanics.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Until-healed remains genuine, not a convenience one-minute duration.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: A legal positive normal-HP healing application cures despite zero gain at real cap; prohibited/invalid heals, tempHP and stabilization-only do not. Actual paid healing still pays.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Complete source-owned healing and reduction/consumption obligations remain distinct.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Ephemeral core within120, radius30 arc reach, up to six perceived chosen enemies, one shared5d6 and independent DEX full/half.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: A routine finite completion; no random Chain Arc target list, spare-arc concentration or core object.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: DelayedGrowth
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Start6d6; +1 per completed6seconds, cap12d6, actual establishment+60. Before deadline use actualBA; exactly at deadline one automatic consumed blast, no second BA or callback.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Explicitly selects missing formula and terminal precedence while preserving printed cap.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.label: DelayedLife
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Own loss/removal before claim extinguishes harmlessly; suppressed manual/deadline claim consumes harmlessly; no paused clock. Original caster roots arise at operative detonation.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: A suppression ending does not replay or rearm. Consume concentration before blast; actual target prevention stays local.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: All outcomes specified rather than external-game color table, no eighth/double ray or cosmology.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.selectedAnswer: Explicitly adopt native60ft circular cone with radius=s/2, actual whole-body/cover; hard Stunned admission separate from damage.
questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Every row has complete failure and success/admission-defense case. No raw-result DE4 expansion.

questionAnswersInOriginalOrder.reasonAndTradeoff: Keeps both printed functions with declared finite duration and displacement.
